Write each once in «outfits», with its «id» before its improved items. Choose for «case» — her occasion, «intent», «goal», her own words — so that their ideas differ. Read every outfit of «verdict» before you choose: «verdict» comes in an order drawn by lot, and an outfit's place in it says nothing about her. Do not choose by how many remarks an outfit has or how mild they are: an outfit that answers her better stays with its remarks.","«outfits» is your ordered selection, each outfit improved; an outfit you did not choose is not written.","An improved outfit is whole: «items» lists all its items, the ones you kept and the ones you put in; an item leaves it only when you replace it or remove it for a finding.","A remark (a finding without «register» «gate») is information about the outfit: it does not by itself drop an outfit or undo a move you declared. Change an item for a remark only when that makes the outfit answer her case better. A finding without «fix» asks for no change.","When «case» has «palette_scheme», she chose that scheme herself: keep its families on the large items of the outfits that carry them, and do not repair her scheme away into neutrals; give a missing family a large item from «showcase» where one fits her occasion.","One item of each kind: an item of a kind the outfit already has replaces it; a missing kind is added without removing other items. A section with item gives the vector for that single item. null means no knowledge supplied. Vector indices refer to facts in property order. defaults is the explicit complete three-index vector: append its trailing indices to a shorter vector; a scalar is a one-index vector.
